_doc: The strings the Event tile screen shows, and nothing else. It exists because X-04 requires every user-facing string to be a loc key in EN and DE from day one, and because ContentInvariants.CheckLocaleKeyReferences fails a loc key that nothing in the content set names — a key referenced only from C# is an orphan, and an orphan is fatal. This document is that naming. ⚠️ The directory is `event_screen/` rather than `event/` on purpose: `schema/event.schema.json` already governs the live-ops event package, `schema/events.schema.json` the framework-wide tuning file, and `schema/board_events.schema.json` the cards this very screen shows. Four names a letter and a word apart is a real hazard, and this document takes the one none of the other three could be mistaken for. 🔴 The CARD PROSE IS NOT HERE. A card's title, its body and each option's label are free English strings in board_events.json rather than loc keys, so the locale check never sees them and a German player reads the card in English until a content pass re-authors them; what this document carries is the screen's own chrome, which is fully localised. Deliberately absent: any currency caption, because tuning/currencies.json already names all eight currencies through its own keys and a second copy here would be free to drift out of step with the wallet it describes; and any outcome wording, because what an option pays is drawn by weight at choose time and most shipped outcomes are UNSUPPORTED — which is why `status.nothingHappened` is the common answer on this screen and not an edge case. ⚠️ `label.wallet` captions the wallet SECTION of the result panel, not a row inside it: the rows are captioned by the currency's own name, and without a section caption a wallet payout would appear as bare currency names under a screen that had already used `label.result` for the Gold and HP rows above them.
